title: Fix CLI lint view label path resolution
body:
## Summary
- Fix CLI lint view-label validation to read canonical `list.label` and `listViews.*.label` paths
- Keep missing-label diagnostics on schema-supported list view label paths
- Add focused regression coverage for default and named list view labels

Fixes #1554

## Tests
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/lint-view-label.test.ts`
